identity_verification_limits.static_hosting_context: User-agent curl checks prove response parity only, not crawler identity. Spoofed UAs receive the same static bytes from Netlify/export. Where operators publish bot IP ranges or reverse-DNS guidance (e.g. OpenAI, Google), verify at CDN/WAF or log layer when available.
recommended_checks: Local static-server UA fetch parity (this repo)
Optional D3_LIVE_URL deploy/preview curls with same UAs
Operator-published IP lists and reverse-DNS where applicable
Netlify / edge access logs when accessible
